description:
Brand Introduction: ADAH LAZORGAN has been a leader in the beauty industry for over 50 years, dedicated to elegance, quality, and innovation. Our mission is to empower individuals to enhance their natural beauty, exuding confidence in all aspects of life.

Product Description: We offer a wide range of beauty products, including skincare, makeup for face, brows, eyes, lips, and accessories. Our products are designed to inspire and transform, reflecting the highest standards of quality and innovation.

USP (Unique Selling Point): Our unique influencer program offers not only a lucrative commission structure but also opportunities for deeper brand involvement, including exclusive events, personalized product lines, and prestigious brand ambassador roles.

Payment Terms:

  • Base Tier: 8% commission
  • Silver Tier: 12% commission (monthly sales >$15,000)
  • Gold Tier: 15% commission (monthly sales >$30,000)
  • Platinum Tier: 20% commission + co-create a private label series (monthly sales >$50,000)

Other Information: Influencers will receive a curated selection of ADAH products and a personalized affiliate link. We value authentic connections and content that showcases real-life integration of our products. Top performers have the chance to embark on exclusive journeys, lead marketing campaigns, and gain early access to new products.

Join us in our journey of beauty and empowerment, and grow with ADAH LAZORGAN.

ADAH Inc. Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Introduction

These Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern the participation in the ADAH Inc. Affiliate Program ("Program"). By signing up or participating in the Program, you ("Affiliate") agree to comply with these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, you are not permitted to participate in the Program.

Enrollment in the Program

  1. Application: To enroll in the Program, you must submit a complete and accurate application via the ADAH Inc. website. ADAH Inc. reserves the right to accept or reject any application at its sole discretion.

  2. Eligibility: Affiliates must be at least 18 years old. Affiliates must also comply with all applicable laws and regulations in their jurisdiction.

Affiliate Responsibilities

  1. Promotion: Affiliates are responsible for promoting ADAH LAZORGAN products and services through approved marketing channels. Affiliates must use only the provided promotional materials, including banners, links, and text ads.

  2. Compliance: Affiliates must comply with all applicable laws, including but not limited to, advertising and consumer protection laws. Affiliates must not engage in deceptive, misleading, or unethical practices.

  3. Prohibited Activities: Affiliates may not use spam, unsolicited email, pop-up or pop-under advertisements, or any other forms of intrusive marketing. Affiliates may not bid on ADAH LAZORGAN trademarks or use ADAH LAZORGAN trademarks in domain names.

Commissions and Payments

  1. Commission Structure: Affiliates will earn a commission on qualifying purchases made by referred customers who follow the affiliate link. The commission rate and structure will be detailed in the Affiliate Dashboard.

  2. Payment Terms: Commissions will be paid monthly, provided the Affiliate's account balance meets the minimum payout threshold. Payments will be made via PayPal, and Affiliates are responsible for any transaction fees.

  3. Returns and Chargebacks: Commissions will not be paid on orders that are canceled, returned, or refunded. If a commission has already been paid for such orders, it will be deducted from future payments.

Affiliates grant ADAH Inc. a non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual, and worldwide license to use, reproduce, distribute, display, and create derivative works from any content uploaded by Affiliates that carries the ADAH LAZORGAN brand name. This includes but is not limited to content shared on all social media platforms, websites, and other marketing channels without limitation.

Termination

  1. Termination by ADAH Inc.: ADAH Inc. reserves the right to terminate an Affiliate's participation in the Program at any time, with or without cause. Reasons for termination may include, but are not limited to, violation of these Terms, engaging in prohibited activities, or any behavior that ADAH Inc. deems harmful to its reputation or business.

  2. Termination by Affiliate: Affiliates may terminate their participation in the Program at any time by providing written notice to ADAH Inc.

  3. Effect of Termination: Upon termination, Affiliates will cease using all promotional materials and links provided by ADAH Inc. Commissions earned prior to the termination date will be paid in accordance with the standard payment terms, provided the minimum payout threshold is met.

Confidentiality

Affiliates agree to maintain the confidentiality of all non-public information disclosed by ADAH Inc. during the course of their participation in the Program. This includes, but is not limited to, marketing strategies, commission rates, and proprietary data.

Modification of Terms

ADAH Inc. reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of any changes via email or through the Affiliate Dashboard. Continued participation in the Program after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
